title: Replicating the Goodhart critical-threshold: does true reward really collapse past a measurable optimization point?

original_idea.body:
# Replicating the Goodhart critical-threshold

Small MDP with proxy; sweep optimization pressure, locate turnover point across Goodhart types.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: reproducible Goodhart turnover curve gives early-warning thresholds for reward gaming.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tabular/gridworld MDP with best-of-n or Q-learning; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused turnover-curve experiment; repeating across Goodhart types adds breadth.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: toy MDP, no lab resources, reward-gaming question valuable.

novelty.reasoning: Goodhart turnover is theoretically stated and partially demonstrated; the controlled multi-type curve may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Goodhart thresholds are studied; the controlled multi-type curve may be open.
